item.title: Wales pick Lake against Boks after injury scare
item.description:
Injury Scare Behind Lake’s Selection

Wales’ touring captain Dewi Lake has been named in the starting side for the Nations Championship match against South Africa in Durban on Saturday, despite being a major doubt for the clash due to a recent injury scare. The hooker hobbled off in last weekend’s defeat by Argentina, sparking concerns that he may not be fit to face the world champions.

However, head coach Steve Tandy has opted to stick with Lake, who has been selected alongside a new-look centre combination featuring Ben Thomas and Max Llewellyn. The duo will form a crucial partnership in the midfield, as Wales look to test themselves against the physical might of the Springboks.
